distanceMethod: Straight-line distance returned by KTO from the verified event anchor; walking distance and entrance position can differ.
publicationPolicy: Only manually selected records with original visitor-decision guidance are build-readable. API descriptions, hours, prices, and availability are not published automatically.

options.title: Daecheon Port
options.visitorDecision: Use this as a separate harbor stop only when you still have time and dry clothes after the mud zone; it is not a shortcut between festival areas.
options.stopRule: Drop it when heat, rain, cleanup time, or the return schedule makes another exposed waterfront leg a poor trade.

options.title: Ziptrek Korea
options.visitorDecision: Treat this as an optional paid activity, not a default festival add-on; it only fits a visitor who has protected time outside the mud-program schedule.
options.stopRule: Do not build the day around it until the operator confirms current hours, weather operation, price, and same-day capacity.

options.title: Gwangalli Beach Theme Street
options.visitorDecision: This is the low-commitment extension: use it to wait near the viewing area without adding a cross-town transfer, while keeping the final beach position flexible.
options.stopRule: Skip the extra walk when crowd controls, rain, or wind make securing the official viewing area more important.

options.title: Millac The Market
options.visitorDecision: Use this as a meal or indoor waiting candidate before the show, then leave enough buffer to re-enter the beach crowd rather than assuming a quick door-to-viewing-spot transfer.
options.stopRule: Remove it from the plan when venue hours, queues, or the official show notice leave less than a comfortable return buffer.

options.title: National Gugak Museum
options.visitorDecision: This is the strongest culture-on-culture pairing because it stays inside the arts district; allow separate viewing time instead of treating it as a corridor on the way out.
options.stopRule: Drop it if its current opening day or last admission does not leave a complete visit after the Botero exhibition.

options.title: Montmartre Park
options.visitorDecision: Choose this only as a weather-friendly outdoor decompression stop; the longer distance makes it a deliberate second leg, not an automatic museum-neighborhood walk.
options.stopRule: Skip it in rain, high heat, poor air quality, or when the return journey matters more than adding another walking segment.

options.title: Waterworks Museum
options.visitorDecision: Use this as the compact indoor counterweight to a long outdoor garden visit, especially when you want a defined stop rather than more open-ended walking.
options.stopRule: Do not rely on it as a rain shelter until the museum confirms the current opening day, entry window, and any closure notice.

options.title: Hangang River
options.visitorDecision: Add the river only when the garden route still leaves energy for another exposed walking segment; it works better as a scenic extension than as a must-see checkpoint.
options.stopRule: End at the garden when heat, rain, air quality, darkness, or fatigue makes the waterfront extension lower value.

options.title: Sindang-dong Tteokbokki Town
options.visitorDecision: Use this as the nearby meal decision after the exhibition, not as a timed attraction; it minimizes transfer cost but can still add queue time at popular restaurants.
options.stopRule: Choose another meal area when dietary needs, queues, or the exhibition exit time make the cluster a poor fit.

options.title: Dongdaemun Design Plaza
options.visitorDecision: Pair DDP when you want a second design-focused district stop and have a specific exhibition, shop, or architecture goal; the building is too broad to count as one quick attraction.
options.stopRule: Keep the route short when no current DDP program matches your interests or when another indoor venue would crowd the same day.

exclusions.reason: No verified INSPIRE Arena coordinate was available through the authorized English KTO service at review time; no approximate airport coordinate is substituted.
